SEC Launches New Statistics and Data Visualizations Webpage (Press Release 2025-106)

status_summary: DERA published six reports on 2025-04-28, including updated statistics on exempt offerings under Regulations A, D and Crowdfunding through 2024 and multi-year issuance series. The SEC launched a statistics and data visualization webpage on 2025-08-13 covering IPOs, exempt and bond offerings, reporting issuers and other series, which the Chairman described as an unprecedented window into the capital markets. Neither release includes enforcement data or an annual data book, and no change allowing three Commissioners to set the agenda was found.

timeline.event: The SEC announces that DERA published six reports on public issuers, exempt offerings, CMBS, ABS, money market funds and security-based swap dealers, including yearly series on exempt offerings through 2024.

The SEC launches a statistics and data visualization webpage, produced by DERA, covering IPOs, exempt offerings, bond offerings, reporting issuers and other series with time series charts and a downloadable table.
